title: Demand Estimation for Rationally Inattentive Consumers
abstract: arXiv:2610.29600v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We develop a rational-inattention BLP (RI-BLP) model for demand estimation from aggregate market shares, allowing for endogenous prices and unobserved preference heterogeneity. We establish conditions for uniqueness of market-share inversion and construct a simulated RI-BLP GMM estimator with instrumental-variable moments and market-share constraints. Under regularity and simulation-accuracy conditions, the estimator is consistent and asymptotically normal as the number of markets grows, with the number of products fixed. Monte Carlo experiments show accurate recovery of mean utility coefficients, with less precise estimates of dispersion parameters. In a canned-tuna application, RI-BLP and logit yield similar average own-price elasticities. Unlike logit, the fitted RI-BLP model implies that a price increase can reduce demand even for similar products and shift demand toward the outside option.

translated_title: 理性疏忽消费者的需求估计
translated_abstract: 我们开发了一个理性疏忽BLP（RI-BLP）模型，用于从总体市场份额进行需求估计，该模型允许内生价格和不可观测的偏好异质性。我们建立了市场份额反演唯一性的条件，并构建了一个包含工具变量矩条件和市场份额约束的模拟RI-BLP广义矩估计量。在正则性和模拟精度条件下，当市场数量增加而产品数量固定时，该估计量是一致且渐近正态的。蒙特卡洛实验表明，该模型能够准确恢复平均效用系数，但对离散参数的估计精度较低。在金枪鱼罐头的实证应用中，RI-BLP和logit模型得出相似的平均自价格弹性。与logit模型不同，拟合的RI-BLP模型意味着价格上涨即使对相似产品也会减少需求，并将需求转向外部选择。
tldr: 本文提出用于总体市场份额需求估计的理性疏忽BLP（RI-BLP）模型，建立了市场份额反演的唯一性条件并证明模拟GMM估计量的一致性与渐近正态性，实证发现价格上涨会将需求转向外部选择而非相似产品。
en_tdlr: This paper develops a rational-inattention BLP (RI-BLP) model for demand estimation from aggregate market shares, establishes uniqueness conditions for market-share inversion, proves consistency and asymptotic normality of a simulated GMM estimator, and empirically shows that price increases shift demand toward the outside option rather than similar products.
